# Overview Framing Ltd

> Overview Framing Ltd is a framing contractor based in Calgary, Alberta, owned by Brandon Sanguine, with more than 20 years in the framing trade. It frames custom homes, log homes and cabins, timber frames, multi-family buildings, roofs and trusses across Alberta and British Columbia.

## Services
- [Custom home framing](https://northcreststudio.github.io/overview-framing/#services): Full framing packages for custom and spec homes: floor systems, walls, roof and sheathing.
- [Log home and cabin framing](https://northcreststudio.github.io/overview-framing/#services): Framing around log shells: floor systems, roof structures, dormers, porches and interior walls.
- [Timber frames](https://northcreststudio.github.io/overview-framing/#services): Heavy timber trusses, posts and beams, covered porches and gazebos.
- [Multi-family framing](https://northcreststudio.github.io/overview-framing/#services): Framing for townhomes and multi-storey wood buildings.
- [Roof framing and trusses](https://northcreststudio.github.io/overview-framing/#services): Stick-framed and truss roofs, crane-set trusses, overbuilds and roof sheathing.
- [Additions, garages and basements](https://northcreststudio.github.io/overview-framing/#services): Additions, detached garages, basement development and interior walls.

## Questions and answers
### What does a framing contractor do?
A framing contractor builds the structure of a building in wood: floor systems, walls, roof framing and sheathing, following the stamped drawings. Framing comes after the foundation and before mechanical, drywall and finishing trades.

### What does Overview Framing frame?
Overview Framing Ltd frames custom homes, log homes and cabins, timber frames, multi-family buildings and townhomes, roofs and trusses, additions, garages and basements.

### Where does Overview Framing work?
Overview Framing is based in Calgary, Alberta and takes on framing work across Alberta and British Columbia, including mountain and cabin country.

### How much experience does Overview Framing have?
Owner Brandon Sanguine has more than 20 years of experience in the framing trade, on custom homes, multi-family buildings, roofs, and log home and cabin builds.

### What drives the cost of a framing package?
Square footage, number of storeys, roof complexity, trusses versus a stick-framed roof, site access, crane lifts and the schedule. Send your drawings and scope for a price.

### Is framing a log home different from a regular house?
Yes. Log walls settle over time as the logs dry, so framed walls, door and window bucks, stairs and roof posts that meet the logs need settling space or adjustable jacks built in. Roofs are often steeper and heavier for snow.

### How soon can a crew start?
Start dates depend on the schedule and the size of the job. Call early with your drawings and target date so the crew and any crane time can be lined up.

### How do I get a framing quote?
Call or text Brandon at 403-472-2460, email overviewframing@yahoo.com, or send your project details through the quote form on this page. Attach drawings if you have them.
